> [!CAUTION]

releases.name: v3.3.0
releases.body:
# v3.3.0

> [!NOTE]
> We're collecting feedback related to people sharing in this discussion: https://github.com/immich-app/immich/discussions/32196 


Welcome to Immich `v3.3.0`!

This release includes people sharing, birthday memories, auto-stacked mobile edits, and a variety of other enhancements and bug fixes. Keep reading below for the full list of highlights.

## Highlights

* Shared people management
* Birthday memories
* Auto-stacked mobile edits
* Sync OAuth claims on every login
* Higher quality thumbnails and previews
* Machine learning performance and accuracy improvements (opt-in)
* New OCR models
* Notable fix: correct storage size on MacOS

### Shared people management

We are very pleased to release the next big milestone towards better sharing: people can now be shared!

As a user you can share people with another user in your cluster group:

![](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b011c1a2-b81c-47a8-b3d8-159d829fcf82 " =428x659")

aiSummary.oneLiner: A high-performance, self-hosted photo and video backup solution acting as an alternative to Google Photos.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: Immich serves as a comprehensive media management system designed to be hosted entirely on personal infrastructure. It automatically synchronizes photos and videos from mobile devices directly to a private server, bypassing third-party cloud storage. The application leverages machine learning to perform advanced facial recognition and object detection locally without compromising user privacy. Users interact with their media library through highly responsive web and mobile interfaces that rival commercial alternatives. The backend architecture is built to handle massive collections comprising hundreds of thousands of media files effortlessly.
keyFeatures: Automatic synchronization: Backs up media automatically in the background from both iOS and Android devices.
Machine learning: Identifies faces, objects, and locations locally to enable powerful search functionality natively.
Multi-user support: Allows multiple family members to maintain isolated media libraries on a single server instance.
Metadata extraction: Processes EXIF data to organize photos geographically and chronologically with high precision.
Hardware transcoding: Converts unsupported video formats dynamically for smooth playback across all supported platforms.

useCases.title: Data sovereignty
useCases.description: Reclaim total control over personal family photos by migrating away from major corporate cloud providers.

useCases.title: Family media sharing
useCases.description: Deploy a single robust instance to manage and share photo albums securely among multiple family members.

useCases.title: Automated media backup
useCases.description: Ensure mobile device photos are continuously backed up to a reliable local server without manual intervention.

useCases.title: Intelligent photo organization
useCases.description: Organize massive historical photo libraries automatically using local machine learning to identify people and places.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: Privacy advocates and home lab enthusiasts seeking a robust, self-hosted alternative to commercial photo management services. Individuals possessing basic knowledge of Docker and server administration to manage their own data.
